hero.title: Electrical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A degree in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius is an undergraduate course for students who want to study electrical power systems, electronics, industrial automation, renewable energy and electrical equipment. Related undergraduate degrees can be found in Mauritius, including BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering at the University of Mauritius and BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technology at Université des Mascareignes. These options make **Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** a course worth exploring.

overview: Students who want to acquire technical knowledge and build a career in electrical and industrial engineering have good options in these programs. With guidance from **Edu-Hawk Worldwide**, students can compare programs and understand the process to **Study Electrical Engineering in Mauritius**.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Electrical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Electrical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Electrical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
